correctness.rationale: Let a_i=1_{m_i>=theta}; exact population recurrence m_i’=m_i(1-a_{i+1})+m_{i-1}a_i. Inactive colors never reactivate; each maximal proper active run loses its leftmost member per update, and a positive deficient packet moves exactly once into its surviving right endpoint, yielding the exact vertex-level first-periodic entry clock. All active colors cause each vertex to advance each sweep, primitive period q. Extremal n constraints give min(q-2,n-1) at theta=1 and min(q-1,floor((n-1)/theta)) at theta>=2. The zero/subthreshold/active EGFs count all labelled occupancies; a unique near-threshold deficient color dominates conditional nonperiodic states. Independently iterated every state q=3..5 theta=1..3 n=2..5 and compared true periods/entry times to formula. Finite checks corroborate, not prove infinite q,n.
